facts.description: One graph, not separate panels. Horizontal time baseline extends slightly left of the origin and far right with a right arrowhead. Vertical axis extends below baseline and upward with an upward arrowhead. Origin is near pixel (67,160), with O printed below-left. Combined vertical label q, i is above-left; time label t is below the right axis arrow. No grid, numerical scale, calibrated ticks, units, periods, amplitudes, or phase-angle labels.

Heavy solid continuous oscillating curve beginning at the vertical axis above the baseline near an upper extremum, descending immediately to its first zero, then lower extremum, zero, and upper extremum. About two and one-half cycles are drawn. Last segment remains below the baseline and turns upward after its final lower extremum; its finite endpoint is near pixel (880,237). No endpoint dots or arrowheads on this curve.

Thinner solid oscillating curve starts at the origin, immediately goes below the baseline, reaches its first negative extremum, rises through zero, then a positive extremum. It repeats this phase relation. Its finite right endpoint is on the rising side of its last negative lobe near pixel (831,211), before the charge-curve endpoint. Tiny scan/overlap gaps are not a dashed style. No endpoint dots or curve arrowheads.

Both curves share the same frame and approximately the same repeated horizontal spacing. Charge is positive near maximum when current is zero at the origin; current initially becomes negative while charge decreases. Current extrema align approximately with charge zero crossings, and current zeros align approximately with charge extrema. Current's visible vertical excursion is larger than charge's; the shared uncalibrated ordinate does not establish equal physical units or numerical amplitude ratio.

Upper-right Chinese label for charge has a slanting leader extending down-left onto the thick descending charge curve near pixel (732,103). Lower-right Chinese label for current has a slanting leader extending up-right onto the thin descending current curve near pixel (750,241). These are identification leaders, not direction-of-time arrows; no arrowhead is apparent on either leader.

No source circuit subfigure in this image, no numeric ticks or values, no dashed curve, no shading, no point markers, no extra crossings, no physical amplitude calibration, no answer annotation. A small top-left edge ink fragment is outside the mathematical composition and not a label.
